title: AI in Daily Life – From Smart Speakers to Self-Driving Dreams
theme: Artificial Intelligence and its applications in daily life
objectives: Identify and use vocabulary related to Artificial Intelligence (algorithm, automation, chatbot).
Use future forms (will and going to) to talk about plans and predictions.
Discuss advantages and challenges of AI in society using appropriate structures.

self_study.description: Activities for students to complete independently after class.

notes: This is the first of two lessons on AI in Daily Life (Part 1 of 2). Focused on vocabulary, grammar and speaking practice for 60 minutes.
